title: 第9章 意外之喜
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
夜色深沉，万籁俱寂。

    修炼室内，苏牧盘膝坐于蒲团之上，双目微合，双手掐诀搁于膝前，体内运转着《五行养元功》。

    随着他一呼一吸地吐纳，周身有微弱的灵光流转，白日里看不见，夜里石室漆黑一片，倒是看得分明。

    功法等阶从低到高，分为黄、玄、地、天，往上还有传说中的仙阶功法。

    《五行养元功》属黄阶中品，一门烂大街的功法。

    青云宗外门倒是有多部功法可供选择，品阶高的能去到地阶下品。

    奈何资质摆在那，苏牧想选好的也没办法，心有余而力不足。

    功法选择并非品阶越高越好，契合才重要，灵根与功法不契合，事倍功半，越是高级的功法，越是深奥，若是连理解、领悟都做不到，谈何修炼？

    当初拜入宗门时，苏牧仗着脑海里穿越的记忆，自以为是天选主角，便不听劝告固执地选了一门地阶功法，结果连灵气都感应不到，然后退而求其次，选了玄阶，又不行，直到最后换成被人嫌弃的《五行养元功》，才得以引气入体，顺利踏入修行，前前后后浪费了大半年的时间，欲哭无泪。

    《五行养元功》对灵根资质的要求极低，适合任何属性灵根，尤其契合五灵根。

    这门功法以五行相生的原理，需要凝练金、木、水、火、土五种属性元气，然后依次运转，形成一个完整的循环。

    金生水，水生木，木生火，火生土，土生金，每运行一个周天，五种属性的元气便各自壮大一丝。

    虽然单属性的进境远不如专修一门来得快，但胜在根基扎实，五行均衡，不会出现某一种属性过强而打破平衡的隐患。

    也得益于此，苏牧体内的元气浑厚凝练，胜过一般同阶修士，让他在一次次拼杀中获胜，算是欲哭无泪后的一个意外惊喜。

    此刻，他一边催动功法，一边内视监测着体内的状况。

    只见丹田之中，一缕金色元气如火蛇窜动，沿手太阴肺经上行，过中府、云门，入尺泽，经列缺至太渊。

    与此同时，周围空气中游离的灵气被牵引入体，从周身毛孔渗入经脉，经由金灵根转化成金属性元气，与体内元气汇合，涌入丹田气海。

    苏牧全神贯注，一瞬间手诀微变，水属性元气接续而上，沿手少阴心经下行，过少海、通里，入神门，终入气海……

    如此往复，周而复始。

    苏牧沉浸其中，一个周天接着一个周天，孜孜不倦。

    一直到次日午后，他收了功法，长长吐出一口浊气，抬手捏了捏眉心。
content_en:
The night is dark and everything is silent.

    In the training room, Su Mu sat cross-legged on the futon, his eyes slightly closed, his hands making secrets in front of his knees, and the "Five Elements Nourishing Skill" running in his body.

    As he breathed in and out, there was a faint spiritual light flowing around his body. He could not see it during the day. At night, the stone room was dark, but he could see it clearly.

    From low to high, the levels of skills are divided into Huang, Xuan, Earth, and Heaven. There are also legendary immortal level skills going up.

    "Five Elements Yangyuan Gong" belongs to the middle grade of Huangjie, a bad martial art.

    The outer sect of Qingyun Sect has many exercises to choose from, and those with high grades can go to the lower grades.

    However, with his qualifications there, Su Mu had no choice but to choose the right one.

    The selection of exercises does not mean that the higher the grade, the better. The fit is important. If the spiritual root and the exercises are not consistent, it will be half the result with half the effort. The more advanced the exercises, the more profound they are. If you cannot even understand and comprehend, how can you practice?

    When he first joined the sect, Su Mu relied on the time-traveled memories in his mind and thought he was the chosen one. He ignored the advice and stubbornly chose an earth-level technique. As a result, he couldn't even sense the spiritual energy.

    "Five Elements Nourishing Skill" has very low requirements for spiritual root qualifications and is suitable for any attribute spiritual root, especially the five spiritual roots.

    This technique is based on the principle of the five elements' mutual development. It needs to condense the five attributes of metal, wood, water, fire and earth, and then operate them in sequence to form a complete cycle.

    Metal generates water, water generates wood, wood generates fire, fire generates earth, and earth generates metal. Every time it circulates in the sky, the vitality of the five attributes will grow stronger.

    Although the advancement of a single attribute is far faster than that of specializing in one, the advantage is that the foundation is solid and the five elements are balanced, and there will be no hidden danger of a certain attribute being too strong and breaking the balance.

    Thanks to this, the vitality in Su Mu's body was rich and condensed, better than that of ordinary monks of the same level, allowing him to win in battles again and again, which was an unexpected surprise after crying without tears.

    At this moment, while he was activating the exercises, he looked inside to monitor the conditions inside his body.

    In the Dantian, a ray of golden vitality was seen moving like a fire snake, going up along the Taiyin Lung Meridian in the hand, passing through Zhongfu and Yunmen, entering Chi Ze, and reaching Taiyuan through the meridian.

    At the same time, the free spiritual energy in the surrounding air is drawn into the body, seeps into the meridians from the pores of the whole body, is transformed into metallic vitality through the golden spiritual roots, merges with the vitality in the body, and flows into the Dantian Qi sea.

    Su Mu concentrated his attention, and in an instant, the hand technique slightly changed, and the water-attribute vitality continued upwards, descending along the Shaoyin Heart Meridian in the hand, passing through Shaohai, Tongli, entering the Divine Gate, and finally entering the Qi Sea...

    And so on, over and over again.

    Su Mu was immersed in it, working tirelessly week after week.

    It was not until the afternoon of the next day that he stopped the exercise, exhaled a long breath, raised his hand and pinched the center of his brow.
